description.value: Choir of Ash NPCs give you real, actionable information more readily — a stronger, actively usable version of the ancestry's passive recognition.

cinderfall.incomplete: 'Give you real, actionable information more readily' names no skill, no value, and no predicate beyond what A Fingerprint, Not a Coincidence already covers. The card states a bonus/effect but gives no numeric value or formula to build a rule element from without inventing one.
